scope_rule: Do not build the injury ledger from notable-player headlines. Enumerate every fantasy-relevant QB/RB/WR/TE/K plus projected fantasy DST-relevant defensive starters and materially important offensive linemen from each team's camp-opening roster, then resolve every injury/PUP/NFI/IR/recovery/practice-return/preseason-injury event chronologically through Week 1 lock.
current_state_rule: Latest verified state controls current model availability/context; prior states remain retained for chronology and explainability.

chronology.detail: Underwent a cleanup procedure after a PRP injection did not resolve an ankle/heel issue that had affected him during the 2025 season.
Colts said he had not participated in OTAs/minicamp and was expected back at some point in training camp.
Placed on Active/PUP at training camp.
Removed from Active/PUP and returned to practice; initial work was limited and the club said a ramp-up period was required.
Went through pregame work but did not play in the preseason finale; Week 1 remains the target, so current state is improving but not yet a verified full-game workload.

closure_gate: Every fantasy-relevant player on the camp-opening roster is marked REVIEWED even if no injury occurred.
Every PUP/NFI/IR designation at camp opening is captured.
Every injury sustained during camp or preseason is captured.
Every return-to-practice, activation, setback and Week 1 status update is captured.
Every material OL and defensive-starter injury that can affect team offense, team defense, DST, spreads or totals is captured.
No team may be marked complete from a handful of notable headlines.
Alec Pierce chronology must remain present as a regression case proving pre-camp injury carryover is included.
